summary: Full e2e of the new Beta Testing program: 18 backend tests (all PASS) covering /api/beta/apply (new + idempotent dup + 422 invalid email), auth gates on /api/beta/redeem, /api/beta/status, /api/beta/feedback (all return 401 unauthenticated), and all admin endpoints under Bearer token (mint codes count=3 and count=1+label, list codes, list applications, approve mints a 6-char code and flips status to 'approved', deny flips to 'denied', invite mints+emails, feedback list, stats KPI shape). Frontend: /beta renders hero+4 cards+apply form, valid submit shows 'Application received' success card, resubmit of same email shows 'already-applied' state, browser-native email validation message fires for malformed email. /beta/redeem unauth shows 'Continue with Google' card (beta-redeem-login present). /admin/beta token gate works: wrong token shows 'Invalid admin token.' toast, correct token unlocks all 6 panels (stats, mint, invite, applications, codes, feedback). Approve button click in real UI made the row's approve button disappear and status changed to APPROVED inline with new code. All 8 public routes (/, /doctors, /attorneys, /teachers, /managers, /admin/analytics, /beta, /beta/redeem) return 200 with zero pageerrors. i18n regression on / for AR (RTL applied, no leaked object-warning strings) and ES is clean.

issues: The 'LOCK' label in the top-right looks like a button but does not have a data-testid; consider data-testid='admin-beta-lock' for parity with other admin controls. Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 956 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the beta block into /app/backend/routes/beta.py and admin endpoints into /app/backend/routes/admin_beta.py for maintainability.
Admin token is read in _check_admin via env var — good. No hardcoded credentials in code path observed.
Beta endpoint payload models (BetaApplyPayload, BetaRedeemPayload, BetaFeedbackPayload, AdminInvitePayload) all use Pydantic EmailStr / typed fields — input validation is solid.

POST /api/beta/apply does NOT validate (email,name,role,why) for empty strings beyond what Pydantic enforces; currently a single-char 'x' for name/role/why is accepted. If product wants stricter intake, add min_length=2 constraints.
/api/beta/redeem correctly: 401 unauth, 404 unknown code, 410 exhausted, idempotent if user already beta, increments uses + appends redeemed_by + retro-approves application — clean contract.
All admin list endpoints sort by created_at desc and project away _id — good MongoDB hygiene.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all targeted flows pass, zero pageerrors across 8 routes

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 11 new beta endpoints are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_beta.py — reuse as regression. Happy-path for /api/beta/redeem and /api/beta/feedback requires a real Google session and was NOT executed (only auth-gate / error paths). Resend may return email_sent=false from /admin/beta/applications/{id}/approve and /admin/beta/invite — that is treated as non-blocking per the request (code is still minted and persisted). i18n on / for AR/ES verified — no regression from iteration_11's fix.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration. All beta endpoints behave per the specified contract and the admin UI integration is end-to-end functional.
